title: Walnut and Medjool Date Energy Balls
description: No-bake energy balls made with walnuts, medjool dates, and rolled oats. Perfect for a quick snack or post-workout treat.
instructions: 1. In a food processor, combine chopped walnuts, pitted dates, and chia seeds. Process until well combined.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine oats, coconut flakes, and maple syrup. Mix well.
3. Add the walnut-date mixture to the oat mixture and stir until a dough forms.
4. Use your hands to shape the dough into small energy balls.
5. Place the energy balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set.
7. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
